findings.title: Rapid Response: php2shell, Leaked Critical PHP Vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619)
findings.summary_md: Huntress reported that details of two critical PHP remote code execution flaws, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, leaked on Hacker News on the morning of October 20, 2026 before coordinated disclosure and before patches were available. The post warned defenders to prepare for imminent public disclosure.

findings.title: PHP2Shell: Two Unpatched Critical PHP RCE Flaws (CVSS 9.2) Trigger Emergency Security Alert
findings.summary_md: The Hacker News reported that an advance notice followed a leak on October 20, when a post claimed two PHP remote code execution flaws rated CVSS 10.0 affecting PHP 5 onward would be disclosed on Thursday, October 22. The article warned site owners to prepare for emergency patches.

findings.title: PHP2Shell RCE Exploited: CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619
findings.summary_md: watchTowr publicly confirmed on October 20, 2026 that the rumored PHP vulnerabilities were real and that organizations should take them seriously following observed embargo leaks. The post tracked the evolving disclosure timeline for defenders.

findings.title: PHP2Shell: Critical PHP vulnerabilities patched, update now!
findings.summary_md: Help Net Security reported that the PHP development team released emergency security updates on October 21, 2026 fixing PHP2Shell, two critical vulnerabilities CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 that could let attackers execute code remotely.
